messages.subject: shiny app deploy error
parts:
Hi, I am getting the following error while deploying my application to shinyapps.io.


library(rsconnect)
> rsconnect::deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...
Error: HTTP 404
GET https://api.shinyapps.io/v1/applications/209097
Not Found



can someone help?


Thanks!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: shiny app deploy error
parts:
Did you delete an application previously?
What are the contents of the rsconnect/shinyapps.io subdirectory of your project? You might need to clear it out if you had deleted the application.

If that doesn't resolve the issue, I'll want to know the output of rsconnect::appDependencies() and sessionInfo()
